```{r libraries}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(dplyr)
```

## Read the up and downregulated gene list

```{r Read}
up_genes <- read.csv("/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/Figure 4C/Raw Input/upregulated_genes_Bcells_copd_vs_ns_Sen.csv")

down_genes <- read.csv ("/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/Figure 4C/Raw Input/downregulated_genes_Bcells_copd_vs_ns_Sen.csv")
```

#get entrez id of up/downregulated genes
```{r ENTREZ}
gene_up <- bitr(up_genes$gene,
                fromType = "SYMBOL",
                toType = "ENTREZID",
                OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

gene_up

gene_down <- bitr(down_genes$gene,
                fromType = "SYMBOL",
                toType = "ENTREZID",
                OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

gene_down

```
#KEGG analyses

```{r KEGG}
#KEGG analyses
ekegg_down <- enrichKEGG(
  gene         = gene_down$ENTREZID,
  organism     = "hsa",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

dotplot(ekegg_down, showCategory = 15)

ekegg_down <- as.data.frame(ekegg_down)

head(ekegg_down)


ekegg_up <- enrichKEGG(
  gene         = gene_up$ENTREZID,
  organism     = "hsa",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

dotplot(ekegg_up, showCategory = 15)

ekegg_up <- as.data.frame(ekegg_up)

head(ekegg_up)

write.csv(ekegg_up, "/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/Figure 4C/KEGG_enrichment_results_Sen_Bcells_up.csv", row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(ekegg_down, "/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/Figure 4C/KEGG_enrichment_results_Sen_Bcells_down.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
